items.q: I used to play with Oliver Jackson Jr., do you know him?

ctx.x: Yeah. Do it at the end of the piece, to finish the piece. So it’s like she did that for me once on the streets of New York. I mean she’s another person, she does these amazing things and it’s totally like, what’s Art Baron doing in there, but it’s like, it’s got such a heart and soul. It’s not like let’s do something far out and we’ll call it new music. And that’s what’s great about it. And that’s why I’ve had this really great career that I’ve had to play with. You know I used to worry like if someone, like that…
